decision.reason: [ev-873cf7661375] lists four separate RBAC permission changes in one line: three permissions added (delete pods, get/patch crds, update nodes) and one removed (create nodes). That is several changes with different change types, not a single assertion. It also doesn't say which role or ClusterRole these permissions belong to, how they are delivered (for example, Helm chart vs. manually managed RBAC), or what happens to an environment whose operator does nothing. The surrounding section [ev-bfb089d90d84] only points to the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure, which isn't shown, so the subject, applicability and consequence can't be written from what is here.
